Card Q&A.a: No, Option cards go to the trash after their effects activate, so you still have 9 cards in your trash when the effect checks to see how many cards there are. You don't gain 1 memory.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card when I have 9 cards in my trash, does this card become the 10th card in my trash, allowing me to gain 1 memory?

Effect: [Main] Gain 1 memory for every 10 cards in your trash.
